svg.title: LatentLab: reconstruction is not generation
svg.desc: Measured initial, beta0, and beta1 Gaussian VAE results. Six equal-axis scatter plots distinguish noisy prior samples from posterior-mean reconstructions. The beta1 model still generates many points away from all eight data modes.
svg.text: 128 held-out points | 150 parameters | 800 Adam updates | identical initialization and training seed
Gray: held-out data. Teal: model output. All six plots share axes. Prior samples include likelihood noise.
Posterior-mean reconstructions: decode(mu(x)), not samples from the generative model
Synthetic eight-mode fixture, one seed. Lower reconstruction error does not certify a matched prior or good generation.
